xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="Page hero"><e-div-block configuration-id="Hero ring outer"></e-div-block><e-div-block configuration-id="Hero ring inner"></e-div-block><e-flexbox configuration-id="Hero content"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Hero breadcrumb"></e-paragraph><e-heading configuration-id="Hero title"></e-heading><e-div-block configuration-id="Hero rule"></e-div-block><e-paragraph configuration-id="Hero lead"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

Hero lead.paragraph: We partner with leading manufacturers from Europe and Asia to bring proven hospitality quality to every venue we serve.

style.Page hero: flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: flex-start; min-height: 560px; padding: 118px 100px 117px 100px; overflow: hidden; gap: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(7,31,68,0.96) 0%, rgba(11,47,98,0.78) 55%, rgba(11,47,98,0.3) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/brands-hero-bg.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; @media(--tablet){ min-height: 480px; padding: 96px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ min-height: 0px; padding: 72px 20px; }
style.Hero ring outer: position: absolute; padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; left: 980px; top: -120px; width: 620px; height: 620px; border-width: 1.2px; border-color: rgba(222,175,87,0.45); @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -320px; } @media(--mobile){ left: auto; right: -420px; top: -200px; }
style.Hero ring inner: position: absolute; padding: 0px; min-width: 0px; border-radius: 50%; border-style: solid; z-index: 0; left: 1055px; top: -45px; width: 470px; height: 470px; border-width: 1px; border-color: rgba(222,175,87,0.25); @media(--tablet){ left: auto; right: -245px; } @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Hero content: flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; padding: 0px; width: 780px; max-width: 100%; align-items: flex-start; position: relative; z-index: 1;
style.Hero breadcrumb: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
style.Hero rule: width: 90px; min-width: 90px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
style.Hero lead: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 400; font-size: 17px; line-height: 30px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); width: 560px; max-width: 100%; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 15px; line-height: 26px; }
